words.enDefinition: carrying out an obligation under an enforceable agreement

examples.en: The seminar compared the promised delivery date with the date of contractual performance in a fictional dispute.
examples.zh: 研讨课在虚构争议中，将约定交货日期和「合同履行」日期作了比较。

examples.en: The chart identifies actions that counted as contractual performance under the assumed terms of the agreement.
examples.zh: 图表指出了按假定的协议条款，哪些行为算作「合同履行」。

collocations: measure contractual performance against the terms

words.enDefinition: a legally binding obligation to carry out a promise when any applicable conditions have been met

examples.en: The hypothetical buyer's duty to perform arose only after the seller made a conforming delivery under the agreement.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中，卖方按协议完成合格交付后，买方才承担「履行责任」。

examples.en: We identified whose duty to perform was at issue before reading the fictional court's discussion of breach.
examples.zh: 我们先判断争议涉及谁的「履行责任」，再阅读虚构法院对违约的讨论。

words.enDefinition: an offer by a party to carry out what it owes under the contract

examples.en: The question distinguished the seller's tender of performance from the buyer's later decision to accept it.
examples.zh: 题目区分了卖方「履行的提出」与其后买方作出的接受决定。

examples.en: We discussed whether the attempted handover counted as a tender of performance under the hypothetical clauses.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了拟议的交接是否按假设条款构成「履行的提出」。

words.enDefinition: the date or period when a contractual duty must be carried out

examples.en: The time for performance appeared in a separate schedule attached to the fictional venue agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构场地协议所附的一份独立时间表列出了「履行时间」。

examples.en: We read the signed amendment to see whether it changed the time for performance originally specified.
examples.zh: 我们阅读已签署的修订文本，查看它是否改变了原定「履行时间」。

words.enDefinition: the location at which a particular obligation under a contract is to be carried out

examples.en: The fictional contract named the library entrance as the place of performance for the delivery obligation.
examples.zh: 虚构合同将图书馆入口定为交付义务的「履行地点」。

examples.en: We compared the stated place of performance with the location shown on the hypothetical delivery receipt.
examples.zh: 我们将约定的「履行地点」与假设交付收据上的地点作了比较。

words.enDefinition: how a contractual duty must be carried out under the agreement

examples.en: The annex specified the manner of performance by requiring the contractor's files in a particular format.
examples.zh: 附件要求承包方按固定格式提供文件，由此规定「履行方式」。

examples.en: The fictional dispute concerned the manner of performance even though both sides agreed on the deadline.
examples.zh: 在虚构争议中，双方对截止日期没有分歧，争议集中在「履行方式」。

collocations: dispute over the manner of performance

words.enDefinition: performance that falls short of a contractual requirement for the promised work, goods or service

examples.en: The exercise treated the wrongly sized shelves as defective performance under the fictional workshop agreement.
examples.zh: 练习将尺寸有误的架子视为虚构工坊协议下的「瑕疵履行」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the contract allowed correction of defective performance before the buyer sought another remedy.
examples.zh: 我们讨论合同是否允许在买方寻求其他救济前纠正「瑕疵履行」。

words.enDefinition: completion of only some of what a party promised to do under an agreement

examples.en: The class recorded partial performance because only two of the promised four items had been delivered.
examples.zh: 由于承诺的四件物品只交付了两件，全班将其记为「部分履行」。

examples.en: We separated the value of partial performance from the price of the work still outstanding in the problem.
examples.zh: 我们在题目中将「部分履行」的价值与尚未完成的工作价款区分开来。

words.enDefinition: completion of the essential obligations despite relatively minor defects, under a doctrine that can allow payment subject to deductions

examples.en: The mock court considered substantial performance because the work was usable despite a small omission.
examples.zh: 虚构法院考虑是否存在「实质履行」，因为尽管少做了一小部分，完工部分仍可使用。

examples.en: We discussed substantial performance alongside the cost of fixing unfinished details in the fictional construction dispute.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构施工争议中，将「实质履行」与修补未完细节的成本结合讨论。

words.enDefinition: performance that satisfies all remaining duties required from a party under a contract

examples.en: The final list treated the installation and missing manual together as necessary for complete performance in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习的最终清单将安装和补交缺失说明书一并列为「完全履行」所需事项。

examples.en: We marked complete performance on the timeline only after the last promised item had been delivered.
examples.zh: 只有最后一件承诺交付的物品也已交付，我们才在时间线上标出「完全履行」。

words.enDefinition: exact adherence to the requirements of a term, condition or applicable rule

examples.en: The seminar asked whether strict compliance with the notice wording was necessary under the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 研讨课问，在虚构协议下，对通知措辞是否必须「严格遵守」。

examples.en: We distinguished strict compliance from substantial performance when reading the contrasting classroom decisions about the same condition.
examples.zh: 阅读针对同一条件作出不同结论的课堂判例时，我们区分「严格遵守」和实质履行。

words.enDefinition: an event that must occur before a specified contractual duty becomes due unless its occurrence is excused

examples.en: The contract problem made completion of the inspection a condition precedent to performance of the payment duty.
examples.zh: 合同例题把完成检查定为支付义务的「履行先决条件」。

examples.en: We marked the condition precedent to performance on the timeline before the date on which payment became due.
examples.zh: 我们在时间线上，将「履行先决条件」标在付款到期日之前。

collocations: satisfy a condition precedent to performance
waive a condition precedent to performance
failure of a condition precedent to performance

words.enDefinition: an event whose occurrence ends a duty that otherwise exists, subject to the terms and governing law

examples.en: In the fictional case, the condition subsequent ended the ongoing payment obligation when the stated event occurred.
examples.zh: 在虚构案例中，约定事件发生并触发「解除条件」后，持续的支付义务终止。

examples.en: We drew the condition subsequent after the duty began, using a separate marker for its possible discharge.
examples.zh: 我们把「解除条件」画在义务开始之后，并用单独标记表示该义务可能解除。

collocations: duty discharged by a condition subsequent

words.enDefinition: reciprocal conditions under which each party's duty depends on the other's performance or tender at the same time

examples.en: The model sale treats payment and tender of the goods as concurrent conditions under the agreed exchange.
examples.zh: 示例买卖将付款与提出交货视为约定交换中的「同时履行条件」。

examples.en: We placed the concurrent conditions side by side on the fictional sale's timeline to show their timing.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构买卖的时间线上将「同时履行条件」并排放置，以显示它们的时序。

words.enDefinition: a decision or rule treating a duty as due even though an applicable condition did not occur

examples.en: The mock opinion discussed excuse of condition after finding that the party relying on it obstructed its occurrence.
examples.zh: 虚构判词认定主张该条件的一方阻止了条件成就，随后讨论「条件成就要求的免除」。

examples.en: We distinguished excuse of condition from a finding that the condition had already been met in the problem.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们区分了「条件成就要求的免除」与认定条件本已成就。

words.enDefinition: a term making an obligation depend on whether specified performance satisfies a person under the applicable standard

examples.en: The fictional portrait agreement included a satisfaction clause addressing whether the client approved the finished work.
examples.zh: 虚构肖像委托协议包含「满意条款」，涉及委托人是否认可完成的作品。

examples.en: We examined which standard applied to the satisfaction clause in the assigned comparison of two different agreements.
examples.zh: 在指定的两项协议对照练习中，我们考察判断「满意条款」适用哪种标准。

words.expression: implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
words.lemma: implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
words.zhGloss: 默示诚信与公平交易义务
words.enDefinition: in many US jurisdictions, an implied contractual duty of good faith and fair dealing whose scope depends on governing law
acceptedZhAnswers: 默示诚信与公平交易义务
acceptedEnVariants: implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing

examples.en: The professor contrasted the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing with rewriting a bargain after signing.
examples.zh: 老师将「默示诚信与公平交易义务」与签约之后重写约定区分开来。

examples.en: The case note identifies an implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing in the stated jurisdiction.
examples.zh: 案例注释指出，题设司法辖区认可「默示诚信与公平交易义务」。

collocations: invoke the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
breach of the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing
scope of the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing

words.enDefinition: an express or implied obligation to provide cooperation needed for the other party's performance in the stated context

examples.en: The classroom contract imposed a duty to cooperate by requiring timely access to the workshop space.
examples.zh: 课堂所用合同要求及时开放工坊空间，由此规定「协作义务」。

examples.en: We read the fictional finding that the duty to cooperate included supplying the drawings needed to begin work.
examples.zh: 我们读到虚构裁判认定，「协作义务」包括提供开始工作所需的图纸。

words.enDefinition: a contract principle restricting a party's ability to rely on a failure of performance it wrongfully caused

examples.en: The seminar discussed the prevention principle because the fictional employer withheld access until after the deadline.
examples.zh: 在虚构雇主推迟到截止日期后才开放场地的题设下，研讨课讨论了「阻止履行原则」。

examples.en: We compared the prevention principle with an extension clause that allocated responsibility for delay in the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们将「阻止履行原则」与协议中分配延期责任的顺延条款作比较。

words.enDefinition: a party's voluntary decision to give up reliance on a condition intended for its benefit, where legally effective

examples.en: The problem examined waiver of a condition after the fictional buyer expressly stopped requiring the inspection before completion.
examples.zh: 虚构买方明确放弃完成前的检查要求后，例题讨论了「放弃援引条件」。

examples.en: We considered whether the letter showed waiver of a condition or merely extended the original deadline.
examples.zh: 我们讨论该函是否构成「放弃援引条件」，还是只延长既定期限。

collocations: effect of waiver of a condition

words.enDefinition: a legally recognized giving up of a contractual right inferred from a party's actions under the governing rules

examples.en: The fictional judge considered waiver by conduct because the seller repeatedly accepted deliveries made after the stated date.
examples.zh: 虚构法官考虑是否存在「以行为表示放弃权利」，因为卖方反复接受晚于约定日期的交付。

examples.en: We examined the written objection before deciding whether waiver by conduct could be inferred in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在判断练习中能否推断出「以行为表示放弃权利」之前，我们先查阅书面异议。

words.enDefinition: formal confirmation by a designated person that work has reached a specified contractual completion stage

examples.en: In the hypothetical project, payment follows certification of completion by the person named in the contract.
examples.zh: 假设项目的付款时间线从合同指定人员出具「完工证明」之后开始。

examples.en: We checked the intended stage of work covered by certification of completion on the classroom form.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂表格上核对「完工证明」所针对的工作阶段。

words.expression: time is of the essence clause
words.lemma: time is of the essence clause
words.enDefinition: a term making timely performance of a specified obligation essential, with consequences depending on the governing law
acceptedEnVariants: time is of the essence clause

examples.en: The contract excerpt contains a time is of the essence clause for delivery before a scheduled exhibition.
examples.zh: 合同节选含有一项「时间为要件条款」，适用于预定展览前的交付。

examples.en: We checked whether the time is of the essence clause covered only delivery or all scheduled obligations.
examples.zh: 我们核对「时间为要件条款」只涉及交付，还是覆盖所有有时限的义务。

collocations: include a time is of the essence clause
interpret a time is of the essence clause
scope of a time is of the essence clause

words.enDefinition: a right under an applicable law or agreement to correct nonconforming performance within allowed limits

examples.en: The New York sales exercise asks whether the seller has a right to cure the nonconforming delivery.
examples.zh: 纽约州买卖法练习问，卖方对不合约的交付是否有「补救权」。

examples.en: We compared the proposed replacement date with the deadline specified for the right to cure in the contract.
examples.zh: 我们将拟定更换日期与合同规定的「补救权」行使期限作比较。

collocations: scope of the right to cure

words.enDefinition: a communication identifying a claimed contractual failure, given in accordance with applicable terms or law

examples.en: The case chronology places the notice of breach after the buyer compared the delivered goods with the specification.
examples.zh: 在案例时间线中，买方将交付货物与规格对照后，才发出「违约通知」。

examples.en: We read the notice of breach alongside the contract clause specifying the address for its delivery.
examples.zh: 我们阅读了练习中的「违约通知」以及规定收件地址的条款。

words.zhGloss: 要求提供充分的履行保证
words.enDefinition: under rules such as New York UCC section 2-609, a written request for assurance of due future performance when reasonable grounds for insecurity exist
acceptedZhAnswers: 要求提供充分的履行保证

examples.en: The New York case problem asked whether the written demand for adequate assurance was justified by the circumstances.
examples.zh: 纽约州案例题问，当时的情形能否支持这份书面「要求提供充分的履行保证」。

examples.en: We distinguished a demand for adequate assurance from a declaration that the fictional sale had already ended.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「要求提供充分的履行保证」与宣告虚构买卖已经结束。

collocations: make a demand for adequate assurance
grounds for a demand for adequate assurance

words.enDefinition: credible assurance of due future performance that is sufficient under the applicable sales law and circumstances

examples.en: The class discussed whether the seller's reply gave adequate assurance of performance in the fictional sales case.
examples.zh: 全班讨论在虚构买卖案例中，卖方回函是否提供了「充分的履行保证」。

examples.en: The exercise compared two examples of adequate assurance of performance using the stated commercial facts of each sale.
examples.zh: 练习根据两项买卖各自所述的商业事实，对比了两项「充分的履行保证」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary withholding of performance based on an applicable contractual or legal ground

examples.en: The fictional dispute concerns suspension of performance while the parties wait for information about the promised goods.
examples.zh: 虚构争议涉及各方等待有关约定货物的消息期间，是否可以「中止履行」。

examples.en: We marked suspension of performance as a pause on the classroom timeline, distinct from ending the agreement.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂时间线上将「中止履行」标为一段暂停，并与结束协议区分开来。

words.enDefinition: an offer of delivery in which the goods and the manner of offering them satisfy the contract

examples.en: The fictional seller made a conforming tender by offering the specified goods at the agreed place and time.
examples.zh: 虚构卖方在约定地点和时间准备交付指定货物，构成「合约交付的提出」。

examples.en: We identified the conforming tender after checking the model order's quantity and delivery conditions in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们核对了示例订单的数量和交付条件后，辨认出「合约交付的提出」。

words.enDefinition: an offer of delivery that fails to satisfy one or more requirements of the contract

examples.en: The fictional buyer described the shipment as a nonconforming tender because the cartons contained the wrong size.
examples.zh: 虚构买方表示，纸箱中的货物尺寸有误，属于「不合约的交付提出」。

examples.en: We compared the nonconforming tender with the required quantity and packaging in the hypothetical goods contract.
examples.zh: 我们将「不合约的交付提出」与假设货物合同规定的数量及包装对照。

words.enDefinition: a US sales-law rule generally allowing rejection for nonconformity in goods or tender, subject to exceptions and contractual terms

examples.en: The New York sales worksheet presents the perfect tender rule alongside the separate analysis of a seller's cure.
examples.zh: 纽约州买卖法练习同时介绍「严格合约交付规则」，并单独分析卖方补救。

examples.en: We checked whether the perfect tender rule applied before treating the missing goods as grounds for rejection.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「严格合约交付规则」是否适用，再判断缺货是否构成拒收事由。

collocations: exceptions to the perfect tender rule
scope of the perfect tender rule

words.enDefinition: under sales law such as New York's UCC, placing and holding goods at the buyer's disposal with necessary notice

examples.en: The fictional seller's tender of delivery included making conforming goods available and giving the buyer notice.
examples.zh: 练习中，虚构卖方备妥符合约定的货物并通知买方，构成「备妥交付」。

examples.en: We marked the tender of delivery separately from the later collection time in the New York sales exercise.
examples.zh: 在纽约州买卖法练习中，我们将「备妥交付」与稍后的取货时刻分别标记。

words.enDefinition: a buyer's refusal to accept goods that do not meet contractual requirements when rejection is legally available

examples.en: The fictional example treats rejection of nonconforming goods as an issue before the buyer has accepted the shipment.
examples.zh: 虚构示例把「拒收不合约货物」作为买方接受该批货物之前要讨论的问题。

examples.en: We separated rejection of nonconforming goods from the remedies discussed after acceptance in the New York sales exercise.
examples.zh: 纽约州买卖法练习中，我们区分「拒收不合约货物」与接受货物之后讨论的救济。

collocations: notice of rejection of nonconforming goods

words.enDefinition: a buyer's legal acceptance of tendered goods, which may follow agreement, failure to reject effectively or inconsistent conduct under applicable sales law

examples.en: The teacher separated acceptance of goods from acceptance of an offer on the timeline of the hypothetical sale.
examples.zh: 老师在假设买卖的时间线上区分「接受货物」与承诺要约。

examples.en: The New York problem asked when acceptance of goods followed a reasonable opportunity for inspection.
examples.zh: 在买方有合理检验机会之后，纽约州例题问何时发生「接受货物」。

words.enDefinition: a buyer's withdrawal of prior acceptance of goods under sales-law conditions, including substantial impairment in New York's UCC

examples.en: The fictional buyer argued for revocation of acceptance after discovering a serious defect following the initial inspection.
examples.zh: 在首次检验后发现严重瑕疵，虚构买方主张「撤回对货物的接受」。

examples.en: The New York problem distinguishes revocation of acceptance after a purchase from rejection before acceptance occurs.
examples.zh: 纽约州例题区分购买后「撤回对货物的接受」与接受之前拒收。

collocations: notify a seller of revocation of acceptance

words.enDefinition: a serious reduction in the value of an accepted lot or commercial unit to the buyer, in the stated sales-law context

examples.en: The New York worksheet asks whether the hidden fault caused substantial impairment of value to this hypothetical buyer.
examples.zh: 纽约州练习问，隐蔽瑕疵是否导致货物对这名假设买方的价值发生「严重减损」。

examples.en: We separated substantial impairment in the assigned rule from a minor discrepancy in the goods description.
examples.zh: 我们将指定规则中的「严重减损」与货物描述中的轻微出入区分开。

words.enDefinition: in US sales law, an implied warranty for goods sold by a merchant of that kind, including ordinary fitness, unless properly excluded or modified

examples.en: The New York problem discusses the implied warranty of merchantability for goods from a merchant of that kind.
examples.zh: 纽约州例题讨论了经销该类货物的商人所售货物的「适销性默示担保」。

examples.en: We compared the implied warranty of merchantability with a promise about the buyer's separate specialized use.
examples.zh: 我们将「适销性默示担保」与针对买方另有特殊用途而作出的承诺作比较。

collocations: breach the implied warranty of merchantability
exclude the implied warranty of merchantability
implied warranty of merchantability for goods

words.expression: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.lemma: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
words.zhGloss: 特定用途适用性默示担保
words.enDefinition: an implied US sales warranty arising when the seller has reason to know the buyer's particular purpose and reliance on the seller's skill or judgment, and the buyer relies on it
acceptedZhAnswers: 特定用途适用性默示担保
acceptedEnVariants: implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose

examples.en: The New York problem asks whether an implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose arose at contracting.
examples.zh: 纽约州例题问，订立合同时是否产生「特定用途适用性默示担保」。

examples.en: We distinguished the implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose from suitability for the goods' ordinary use.
examples.zh: 我们区分「特定用途适用性默示担保」与货物适用于普通用途这一要求。

collocations: assert an implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
breach of the implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose
implied warranty of fitness for a particular purpose claim

words.enDefinition: language seeking to exclude or change an otherwise applicable warranty, subject to governing law

examples.en: The mock opinion reviewed whether the warranty disclaimer met the requirements of the assigned New York sales rule.
examples.zh: 虚构判词审查该「担保排除声明」是否符合题目指定的纽约州买卖规则。

examples.en: We read the warranty disclaimer before comparing it with the separate limit on available damages.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读「担保排除声明」，再与单独限制赔偿范围的条款作比较。

words.enDefinition: a seller's assurance under applicable sales law that the transfer conveys good title and, normally, no undisclosed lien

examples.en: The worksheet raised a warranty of title question when a third party claimed the illustrated goods as collateral.
examples.zh: 第三人主张所示货物是其担保物时，习题提出了「权属担保」问题。

examples.en: We discussed the warranty of title separately from whether the goods worked as promised in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「权属担保」与货物能否按承诺使用分别讨论。

collocations: warranty of title in a sale

words.enDefinition: an unexcused failure to perform a duty that has become due under an enforceable contract

examples.en: The mock court considered breach of contract after the seller missed the due date without a recognized excuse.
examples.zh: 卖方错过到期日且无可认可的免责事由后，虚构法院审理了「违约」问题。

examples.en: We listed the promised acts before deciding which omission amounted to a breach of contract in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在判断习题中哪项未做的事构成「违约」前，我们先列出承诺的各项行为。

words.enDefinition: a failure to perform that does not go to the root of the bargain under the applicable legal rules

examples.en: The assignment discusses a minor breach of contract involving a discrepancy that did not defeat the agreement's purpose.
examples.zh: 作业讨论了一项「轻微违约」，涉及一处未使合同目的落空的小出入。

examples.en: We compared minor breach of contract with a serious breach while considering whether termination was available in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们对照「轻微违约」与严重违约，同时讨论能否终止合同。

collocations: allege a minor breach of contract
remedy for a minor breach of contract
damages for a minor breach of contract

words.enDefinition: under English law, a breach serious enough, or of a term classified as a condition, to entitle the other party to terminate

examples.en: The English exercise asked whether losing nearly the entire expected benefit amounted to repudiatory breach.
examples.zh: 英格兰法例题问，几乎完全失去预期合同利益，是否属于「根本性违约」。

examples.en: We distinguished repudiatory breach from the innocent party's later election in the fictional contract dispute.
examples.zh: 在虚构合同争议中，我们区分了「根本性违约」与守约方随后作出的选择。

words.enDefinition: a sufficiently clear statement or conduct before performance is due indicating a refusal or inability to perform a material obligation

examples.en: In the model sales dispute, the clear refusal before delivery was discussed as possible anticipatory repudiation.
examples.zh: 在模拟买卖争议中，交货前明确拒绝履行被作为可能的「预期拒绝履行」讨论。

examples.en: We marked anticipatory repudiation before the original delivery date on the classroom timeline of events.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂事件时间线上，将「预期拒绝履行」标在原定交货日之前。

words.enDefinition: withdrawal of a prior anticipatory repudiation before the applicable legal limits prevent withdrawal

examples.en: The New York problem considers retraction of repudiation after a seller reverses an earlier written refusal.
examples.zh: 卖方推翻先前的书面拒绝后，纽约州例题讨论了「撤回拒绝履行」。

examples.en: We read the position of the retraction of repudiation on the fictional timeline alongside the buyer's response.
examples.zh: 我们查看「撤回拒绝履行」在虚构时间线上的位置，并一并查看买方的回应。

words.enDefinition: a breach arising from failure to perform by the time required under applicable contractual terms

examples.en: The fictional court considered breach by delay even though the seller eventually delivered the promised items.
examples.zh: 虽然卖方最终交付了承诺的物品，虚构法院仍讨论是否构成「迟延违约」。

examples.en: We separated breach by delay from the question of whether the late goods met the required specifications.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「迟延违约」与迟交货物是否达到规定规格的问题。

collocations: loss caused by breach by delay

words.enDefinition: a breach substantially depriving the other party of what the CISG contract entitles it to expect, subject to the treaty's foreseeability limitation

examples.en: The seminar compared fundamental breach under CISG with a merely minor departure in the fictional international sale.
examples.zh: 研讨课在虚构国际买卖中，比较了「《销售公约》下的根本违约」与仅轻微偏离约定的情形。

examples.en: We discussed fundamental breach under CISG after checking what the buyer was entitled to expect under the contract.
examples.zh: 我们先核对买方按合同可期待得到什么，再讨论「《销售公约》下的根本违约」。

collocations: elements of fundamental breach under CISG
avoidance for fundamental breach under CISG

words.zhGloss: 因违约终止合同的权利
words.enDefinition: an entitlement to end the contract for breach when the contract or applicable law provides that remedy
acceptedZhAnswers: 因违约终止合同的权利

examples.en: Under the assigned law, the fictional buyer's right to terminate for breach depended on the failure's severity.
examples.zh: 根据题设法律，该不履行的严重程度决定虚构买方是否享有「因违约终止合同的权利」。

examples.en: The professor distinguished the right to terminate for breach from a claim for compensation alone.
examples.zh: 老师区分了「因违约终止合同的权利」与单纯请求赔偿。

collocations: exercise the right to terminate for breach
scope of the right to terminate for breach
assert a right to terminate for breach

words.enDefinition: a communication stating that an agreement is being brought to an end under a stated contractual or legal basis

examples.en: We located the termination notice on the fictional timeline and compared it with the earlier warning letter.
examples.zh: 我们找到虚构时间线上的「终止通知」，并与此前的警告信对照。

examples.en: The exercise asked whether the termination notice identified the clause it purported to rely on in the contract.
examples.zh: 习题问，该「终止通知」是否指出了它主张所依据的合同条款。

collocations: effective date of a termination notice

words.enDefinition: a party's election to keep a contract in force despite having a right to end it for breach

examples.en: The English law exercise treated affirmation of contract as one possible response to the other party's repudiatory breach.
examples.zh: 英格兰法练习将「确认合同继续有效」视为对另一方根本性违约的一种可能回应。

examples.en: We checked whether the fictional buyer's words clearly amounted to affirmation of contract after learning of the breach.
examples.zh: 我们核对虚构买方知晓违约后的言辞，是否明确构成「确认合同继续有效」。

collocations: affect the right to terminate by affirmation of contract

words.enDefinition: selection among available remedies, especially where the applicable legal rules prevent pursuing inconsistent remedies through final relief

examples.en: The hypothetical appeal concerned election of remedies after the claimant requested two outcomes treated as inconsistent.
examples.zh: 假设上诉涉及「救济方式的选择」，因为原告请求了适用规则视为互不相容的两项结果。

examples.en: We distinguished election of remedies from the alternative claims listed earlier in the mock pleading.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「救济方式的选择」与虚构诉状先前列出的备选请求。

collocations: timing of an election of remedies

words.enDefinition: ending a contract under an agreed right that does not require a breach or other fault

examples.en: The classroom agreement allowed termination for convenience after notice, even if the supplier had performed on time.
examples.zh: 课堂所用协议允许一方通知后「任意终止」，即使供应方一直按时履行。

examples.en: We compared termination for convenience with the separate clause requiring an identified contractual breach before termination.
examples.zh: 我们将「任意终止」与另一个要求先确定具体违约才可终止的条款作比较。

words.enDefinition: ending a contract on the basis of a specified reason such as a serious or uncured breach

examples.en: The fictional dispute about termination for cause turned on whether the relevant reason appeared in the agreed clause.
examples.zh: 有关「因事由终止」的虚构争议取决于相关事由是否写入约定条款。

examples.en: We classified the notice as termination for cause because it expressly relied on a stated contractual default.
examples.zh: 我们将该通知归为「因事由终止」，因为它明确以合同规定的一种违约情形为依据。

words.enDefinition: ending a contract through the parties' agreement under the applicable legal and contractual rules

examples.en: The worksheet treated termination by mutual agreement as a separate event from the seller's earlier proposed withdrawal.
examples.zh: 练习将「合意终止」与卖方先前提议退出区分为两个事件。

examples.en: We looked for both signatures before classifying the fictional document as termination by mutual agreement.
examples.zh: 我们先查看是否有双方签字，再将该虚构文件认作「合意终止」。

collocations: agree to termination by mutual agreement
terms of termination by mutual agreement

words.enDefinition: the ending of contractual duties once the performance that satisfies them is completed

examples.en: The last item on the classroom timeline marked discharge by performance after all remaining obligations had been satisfied.
examples.zh: 课堂时间线最后一项标为「义务因履行而消灭」，此时所有剩余义务均已履行。

examples.en: We compared discharge by performance with cancellation before the work was finished in a separate hypothetical.
examples.zh: 我们将「义务因履行而消灭」与另一个假设中工作完成前取消合同的情况比较。

collocations: discharge by performance of contractual duties

words.enDefinition: under English law, automatic discharge of future duties when an event outside the parties' fault and risk allocation makes performance radically different

examples.en: The English law problem tested discharge by frustration after the sole agreed venue became permanently unavailable.
examples.zh: 合同唯一指定的场地永久无法使用后，英格兰法例题考查「合同受挫自动解除」。

examples.en: We contrasted discharge by frustration with relief expressly provided by the fictional agreement's event clause.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同受挫自动解除」与虚构协议事件条款明确提供的救济作比较。

collocations: contract subject to discharge by frustration

words.enDefinition: a contractual provision specifying events beyond a party's control and the resulting relief or changes in obligations

examples.en: The fictional force majeure clause listed events and described what would happen to the time for performance.
examples.zh: 虚构的「不可抗力条款」列明了各类事件，并规定履行时间将如何变化。

examples.en: We checked whether the force majeure clause addressed a temporary interruption or allowed the agreement to end.
examples.zh: 我们核查「不可抗力条款」是针对暂时中断，还是允许终止协议。

collocations: scope of a force majeure clause

words.enDefinition: an event treated as beyond a party's control and qualifying for relief under the applicable contract or law

examples.en: The hypothetical court asked whether the unexpected venue closure was a force majeure event under the written clause.
examples.zh: 假设法院问，突发的场地关闭按书面条款是否构成「不可抗力事件」。

examples.en: We identified the alleged force majeure event before discussing whether it had caused the delay in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先找出题目所主张的「不可抗力事件」，再讨论它是否造成延期。

collocations: delay caused by a force majeure event

words.enDefinition: under some US contract rules, a ground for excusing performance made impracticable by a contingency whose nonoccurrence was a basic assumption

examples.en: The New York exercise considered commercial impracticability after a contingency undermined a basic assumption of the sale.
examples.zh: 某项偶发事件打破买卖的基本假设后，纽约州习题讨论了「商业上不能合理履行」。

examples.en: The class distinguished commercial impracticability from an ordinary increase in a fictional supplier's costs.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「商业上不能合理履行」与虚构供应方成本的一般上涨。

words.enDefinition: an impossibility of performance arising from an event occurring after a contract was made

examples.en: The hypothetical dispute raised supervening impossibility after the sole object promised in the sale was accidentally destroyed.
examples.zh: 买卖中唯一承诺的物件意外毁损之后，假设争议提出了「嗣后履行不能」问题。

examples.en: We distinguished supervening impossibility from an obstacle already present when the fictional parties reached their agreement.
examples.zh: 我们将「嗣后履行不能」与虚构当事人达成协议时就已存在的障碍区分开。

words.enDefinition: under some US contract rules, substantial defeat of the agreement's principal purpose by a supervening event assumed not to occur

examples.en: The seminar considered frustration of purpose after the fictional event was canceled despite the room remaining available.
examples.zh: 虚构活动取消、房间仍可使用的情况下，研讨课讨论了「合同目的落空」。

examples.en: We identified the agreement's principal purpose before discussing frustration of purpose under the assigned US rule.
examples.zh: 我们先判断协议的主要目的，再根据指定的美国规则讨论「合同目的落空」。

words.enDefinition: a term assigning responsibility for specified uncertainties or events to one or more parties

examples.en: The risk allocation clause stated who would bear certain costs if the hypothetical delivery was interrupted.
examples.zh: 「风险分配条款」规定，如果假设的交付中断，由谁承担某些费用。

examples.en: We read the risk allocation clause before assuming that an unexpected event excused the seller in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在认定意外事件能免除习题中卖方的责任之前，我们先阅读了「风险分配条款」。

collocations: risk allocation clause in a supply contract

words.enDefinition: a term allocating the contractual consequences of a change in legislation or another specified legal requirement

examples.en: The fictional change in law clause stated how a newly applicable rule might affect the project timetable.
examples.zh: 虚构的「法律变更条款」规定一项新适用规则可能怎样影响项目时间表。

examples.en: We checked the definition of covered changes in the change in law clause on the classroom contract.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂合同的「法律变更条款」内核对所涵盖变更的定义。

collocations: invoke a change in law clause
scope of a change in law clause
interpret a change in law clause

words.enDefinition: delay for which a contractual or legal rule provides relief from stated consequences

examples.en: The model timetable labels two days as excused delay under a provision supporting an extension of time.
examples.zh: 示例时间表根据允许顺延期限的条款，将其中两天标为「可免责的迟延」。

examples.en: We checked which effects of excused delay the fictional contract specified before considering a payment adjustment.
examples.zh: 讨论调整付款前，我们先检查虚构合同对「可免责的迟延」规定了哪些后果。

words.enDefinition: the transfer of an existing contractual right to another person, subject to legal and contractual limits

examples.en: The fictional document describes an assignment of contractual rights involving payments due under a supply agreement.
examples.zh: 这份虚构文件描述了涉及供货协议下到期款项的「合同权利转让」。

examples.en: We mapped the assignment of contractual rights separately from the party still responsible for performing the work.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同权利转让」的关系与仍负责履行工作的当事人分别标示。

collocations: make an assignment of contractual rights
notice of assignment of contractual rights

words.zhGloss: 委托他人履行合同义务
words.enDefinition: arrangement for another person to perform a contractual duty, with the original party's liability depending on the governing rules
acceptedZhAnswers: 委托他人履行合同义务

examples.en: The exercise distinguished delegation of contractual duties from an agreement releasing the original contractor altogether.
examples.zh: 练习区分了「委托他人履行合同义务」与完全解除原承包方责任的协议。

examples.en: We identified delegation of contractual duties when a substitute was asked to carry out the promised work.
examples.zh: 另一人受托完成已承诺的工作时，我们辨认出「委托他人履行合同义务」。

collocations: effect of delegation of contractual duties

words.enDefinition: a consensual replacement of a contractual obligation or party with a new one, extinguishing the relevant old obligation

examples.en: The hypothetical parties signed a novation that substituted a new obligor and released the original one.
examples.zh: 假设当事人签订了「合同更替」协议，以新债务人代替原债务人并免除后者责任。

examples.en: We compared novation with a transfer of payment rights that left the original performance duties in place.
examples.zh: 我们将「合同更替」和仅转让付款请求权、原履行义务仍存续的情形作比较。

words.enDefinition: an agreement to accept substituted performance for an existing obligation, together with performance of the agreed substitute

examples.en: The fictional judge considered accord and satisfaction after the parties agreed to and completed a substitute delivery.
examples.zh: 当事方同意并完成替代交付后，虚构法官审理是否构成「和解协议与履行」。

examples.en: We separated the agreement and its completed execution when labeling accord and satisfaction on the classroom timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂时间线上标出「和解协议与履行」时，分别标明协议订立和协议履行完毕。

collocations: discharge a claim by accord and satisfaction

words.enDefinition: a legally effective surrender of specified claims arising under or connected with a contract

examples.en: We read the release of contractual claims to see which disputed invoices were listed in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「放弃合同请求权」的文件，查看练习中列出了哪些有争议的发票。

examples.en: The hypothetical agreement contains a limited release of contractual claims covering only the earlier delivery issue.
examples.zh: 假设协议中「放弃合同请求权」的范围有限，仅覆盖先前的交付问题。

collocations: execute a release of contractual claims
scope of a release of contractual claims
interpret a release of contractual claims

words.enDefinition: a provision identifying obligations or rights that continue after a contract otherwise terminates or expires

examples.en: The survival clause in the fictional agreement kept a confidentiality duty in effect after the contract expired.
examples.zh: 在虚构协议中，「存续条款」使保密义务在合同期满后继续有效。

examples.en: We checked the survival clause before deciding which duties remained on the classroom timeline after termination.
examples.zh: 在判断课堂时间线上的合同终止后还剩哪些义务之前，我们先核对了「存续条款」。

collocations: obligation covered by a survival clause

words.enDefinition: a contractual entitlement that has arisen before a later event such as termination of the agreement

examples.en: The claim for payment already due was classed as an accrued contractual right in the hypothetical case.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中，要求支付已到期款项的权利被归为「已产生的合同权利」。

examples.en: We marked when the accrued contractual right arose relative to the termination date on the fictional timeline.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构时间线上标出「已产生的合同权利」何时产生，并与终止日期对照。

collocations: waiver of an accrued contractual right

words.enDefinition: a term providing that stated remedies may be used alongside other available remedies, subject to applicable limitations

examples.en: The fictional cumulative remedies clause allowed the remedies listed in the contract to coexist with others under law.
examples.zh: 虚构的「救济可并行条款」允许合同列出的救济与其他法定救济并存。

examples.en: We discussed whether the cumulative remedies clause affected the separate rule against receiving compensation twice in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「救济可并行条款」是否影响练习中另外适用的禁止重复获赔规则。

collocations: effect of a cumulative remedies clause

words.enDefinition: a provision limiting a party to a designated remedy for a specified failure, if given effect under the governing law

examples.en: The exclusive remedy clause designated replacement as the contractual response to a particular defect in the fictional sale.
examples.zh: 在虚构买卖中，「排他性救济条款」指定更换为针对特定瑕疵的合同救济。

examples.en: We considered whether the exclusive remedy clause left any other remedies for the hypothetical buyer under applicable law.
examples.zh: 我们讨论依据适用法律，「排他性救济条款」是否给假设买方保留了其他救济。

collocations: scope of an exclusive remedy clause

words.enDefinition: a provision seeking to restrict the amount, scope or kinds of liability arising under an agreement

examples.en: The limitation of liability clause stated a maximum amount for certain claims in the fictional services contract.
examples.zh: 在虚构服务合同中，「责任限制条款」规定某些请求的最高责任金额。

examples.en: We checked whether the limitation of liability clause covered the particular obligation identified on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们核对「责任限制条款」是否涵盖课堂习题中指出的那项义务。

collocations: interpret a limitation of liability clause
enforce a limitation of liability clause
scope of a limitation of liability clause

words.enDefinition: a provision seeking to remove liability for specified events, losses or breaches, subject to applicable law

examples.en: The hypothetical court considered whether the exclusion clause covered the type of loss claimed under the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 假设法院讨论「责任排除条款」是否涵盖虚构协议下提出的那种损失。

examples.en: We marked the exclusion clause separately from the provision that capped all other covered claims in the contract.
examples.zh: 我们将「责任排除条款」和为其他适用请求设定最高额的合同条款分别标出。

words.enDefinition: a ceiling on the amount recoverable for specified liabilities under an agreement or legal rule

examples.en: The exercise compared the allowed claim with the liability cap written into the fictional agreement's schedule.
examples.zh: 练习将准许的请求额与虚构协议表中写明的「责任限额」作比较。

examples.en: We discussed whether one liability cap applied across all claims or separately to each claim in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论一项「责任限额」是适用于全部请求的合计金额，还是分别适用于每项请求。

words.enDefinition: a contract term seeking to exclude loss categorized as consequential under the applicable interpretation and law

examples.en: The seminar considered how to interpret the consequential loss exclusion in the hypothetical supply contract's particular wording.
examples.zh: 研讨课结合假设供货合同的具体措辞，讨论如何解释「后果性损失排除」。

examples.en: We compared consequential loss exclusion with the separate cap on claims that were still covered in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们将「后果性损失排除」与练习中对仍列入保障范围的请求另设的上限作了比较。

collocations: rely on a consequential loss exclusion
scope of a consequential loss exclusion

words.enDefinition: a term by which one party assumes an obligation to cover specified losses, liabilities or claims of another

examples.en: The fictional indemnity clause listed which third-party claims the supplier agreed to cover under the service contract.
examples.zh: 虚构的「补偿责任条款」列出了供应方同意按服务合同承担的第三方请求。

examples.en: We compared the indemnity clause with the damages provision to understand their separate functions in the classroom agreement.
examples.zh: 我们将「补偿责任条款」与赔偿条款相对照，了解二者在课堂协议中的不同作用。

words.enDefinition: an obligation under an agreement to provide or pay for another party's defense against certain claims

examples.en: The fictional agreement imposed a contractual duty to defend specified third-party claims before their merits were decided.
examples.zh: 虚构协议规定，在特定第三方请求的实体争议得到裁判前，当事方须承担「合同约定的抗辩义务」。

examples.en: We compared when the contractual duty to defend arose with when any payment for covered loss was due.
examples.zh: 我们对照「合同约定的抗辩义务」的发生时间与所涵盖损失的付款到期时间。

collocations: trigger a contractual duty to defend
scope of a contractual duty to defend
enforce a contractual duty to defend

words.enDefinition: a term fixing an amount or formula payable for a specified breach, if enforceable under governing law

examples.en: The fictional liquidated damages clause used a daily amount tied to late completion of the specified work.
examples.zh: 虚构的「约定损害赔偿额条款」为指定工作迟延完工设置了按天计算的金额。

examples.en: We examined the liquidated damages clause under the legal test assigned in the English contract law seminar.
examples.zh: 我们依照英格兰合同法研讨课指定的法律检验标准，审查「约定损害赔偿额条款」。

collocations: amount under a liquidated damages clause

words.enDefinition: in English contract law, a term imposing a secondary obligation upon breach with a burden out of proportion to the innocent party's legitimate interest in performance

examples.en: The English law seminar asked whether the stipulated obligation amounted to an unenforceable penalty clause in its context.
examples.zh: 英格兰法研讨课问，结合具体情境，约定义务是否构成不可执行的「惩罚性条款」。

examples.en: We referred to the protected interest before discussing the alleged penalty clause in the assigned English judgment.
examples.zh: 在讨论指定英格兰判决中被主张为「惩罚性条款」的条款前，我们先明确了受保护利益。

collocations: distinguish a penalty clause from liquidated damages

words.enDefinition: money awarded or payable in response to a contractual breach, under the applicable measure and liability rules

examples.en: The exercise compared two calculations of damages for breach of contract using different assumptions about the promised delivery.
examples.zh: 练习基于关于约定交付的不同假定，对照两种「违约损害赔偿」计算结果。

examples.en: We explained which losses the mock court included in damages for breach of contract under the assigned rule.
examples.zh: 我们解释虚构法院根据适用规则，将请求的哪些损失纳入「违约损害赔偿」。

collocations: claim damages for breach of contract
award damages for breach of contract
assess damages for breach of contract

words.enDefinition: money aimed at putting the injured party in the economic position it would have occupied had the contract been performed

examples.en: The worksheet used expectation damages to compare the promised position with the actual position after the hypothetical breach.
examples.zh: 习题用「期待利益损害赔偿」比较按约履行时的经济地位与假设违约后的实际经济地位。

examples.en: We deducted the expenses the claimant saved when calculating expectation damages in the classroom example of nonperformance.
examples.zh: 在课堂不履行案例中，我们计算「期待利益损害赔偿」时扣除了请求人节省的费用。

words.enDefinition: the value of receiving the contractual performance or benefit of the bargain as promised

examples.en: The court diagram illustrates the expectation interest by showing what the fictional claimant would have received upon performance.
examples.zh: 裁判示意图展示合同履行后虚构请求人本可获得的利益，从而说明「期待利益」。

examples.en: We distinguished the expectation interest from simply recovering the money spent preparing for the performance in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分「期待利益」与单纯取回为履行而支出的费用。

words.enDefinition: money aimed at compensating losses incurred by relying on the contract, subject to the governing rules

examples.en: The hypothetical claim for reliance damages included preparation expenses tied to the agreement that the supplier later broke.
examples.zh: 在假设案例中，「信赖利益损害赔偿」请求包含与供应方后来违反的协议有关的筹备费用。

examples.en: We separated reliance damages from the predicted profits that would have followed full performance in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们把「信赖利益损害赔偿」和练习中完全履行后本可获得的预期利润区分开。

words.enDefinition: the interest in being restored to the position one would have occupied without relying on the contract

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates the reliance interest with expenses the fictional claimant would have avoided without the agreement.
examples.zh: 习题用虚构请求人如果没有信赖该协议本可避免的费用，说明「信赖利益」。

examples.en: We compared the reliance interest with the value of the performance promised by the hypothetical supplier in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「信赖利益」与假设供应方承诺履行的价值作了比较。

words.enDefinition: the interest in recovering the value of benefits one has conferred on another in connection with the agreement

examples.en: The professor used the restitution interest to focus on the value transferred to the other fictional party.
examples.zh: 老师通过「返还利益」，让学生关注给到虚构对方当事人的价值。

examples.en: We identified the restitution interest by tracing which party received the advance in the classroom problem.
examples.zh: 我们通过追踪练习中哪一方收到了预付款，明确了「返还利益」。

collocations: recovery based on the restitution interest

words.enDefinition: a small sum awarded in some legal systems to recognize a violation when compensable loss is not established

examples.en: The hypothetical court awarded nominal damages after finding a breach without proof of a compensable financial loss.
examples.zh: 假设法院认定发生违约，但没有证据证明存在可赔偿的财务损失，遂判给「名义损害赔偿」。

examples.en: We reviewed nominal damages separately from compensation measured by the size of a proved loss in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将「名义损害赔偿」与按照已证明损失金额计算的赔偿分别复习。

words.enDefinition: compensation for loss arising naturally from the breach, as distinguished from further loss under the governing law

examples.en: The example treated the goods' reduced value as direct damages for breach under the assigned rule.
examples.zh: 按题设规则，示例将退回货物价值的减少计入「违约直接损失赔偿」。

examples.en: We separated direct damages for breach from claimed losses arising through the buyer's downstream business arrangements in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分「违约直接损失赔偿」与买方因下游业务安排产生并主张的损失。

words.enDefinition: compensation for further loss flowing from breach through the injured party's circumstances, subject to applicable remoteness and proof rules

examples.en: The hypothetical retailer sought consequential damages for breach for a separate loss linked to its promised resale.
examples.zh: 假设零售商就与已承诺转售有关的额外损失，请求「违约后果性损失赔偿」。

examples.en: We reviewed the stated circumstances before deciding whether the assigned rule allowed consequential damages for breach.
examples.zh: 在依据指定规则判断能否获得「违约后果性损失赔偿」之前，我们先查阅所述情形。

words.zhGloss: 《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿
words.enDefinition: in US sales law, compensation for qualifying commercially reasonable expenses incurred in responding to a breach
acceptedZhAnswers: 《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿

examples.en: The New York sales exercise discussed incidental damages under UCC for reasonable costs connected with the rejected delivery.
examples.zh: 纽约州买卖法练习讨论因拒收交货产生的合理费用能否获得「《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿」。

examples.en: We compared incidental damages under UCC with claimed lost sales when sorting the fictional buyer's expense list.
examples.zh: 我们整理虚构买方的费用清单时，将「《统一商法典》下的附带损失赔偿」与所主张的销售损失比较。

words.enDefinition: under sales rules such as New York's UCC, a reasonable good-faith procurement of substitute goods after seller breach

examples.en: The class described the reasonable substitute purchase as buyer's cover under the assigned New York sales law.
examples.zh: 全班按指定的纽约州买卖法，将合理的替代购买称为「买方替代采购」。

examples.en: We marked the buyer's cover separately from the original order on the timeline for the fictional dispute.
examples.zh: 我们在虚构争议时间线上，将「买方替代采购」与原始订单分开标示。

words.enDefinition: under applicable US sales law, recovery based on the cost of cover less the contract price, with permitted adjustments

examples.en: In the New York exercise, cover damages started from the difference between the replacement and contract prices.
examples.zh: 在纽约州练习中，「替代采购差额赔偿」从替代货物价格与合同价的差额算起。

examples.en: We considered saved expenses when reviewing cover damages for the fictional buyer under the specified sales rule.
examples.zh: 我们按指定买卖规则审查虚构买方的「替代采购差额赔偿」时，考虑了节省的费用。

words.enDefinition: damages based on a comparison between contract price and market price at the time and place specified by governing law

examples.en: The model market damages calculation used a market quotation from the date required by the New York rule.
examples.zh: 示例的「市价差额赔偿」计算采用纽约州规则规定日期的市场报价。

examples.en: We compared market damages with the result based on a replacement purchase in the fictional sales problem.
examples.zh: 在虚构买卖例题中，我们将「市价差额赔偿」与按替代采购计算的结果比较。

words.enDefinition: a seller who could and would have made both the breached sale and the later sale, so the later sale does not replace the lost transaction

examples.en: The retailer was a lost volume seller because it could and would have completed both sales.
examples.zh: 由于零售商有能力也本会完成两笔交易，因此属于「销量受损的卖方」。

examples.en: We classified the retailer as a lost volume seller after finding the second transaction would have happened anyway.
examples.zh: 在查明第二笔交易即使无违约也会发生之后，我们将零售商定为「销量受损的卖方」。

collocations: claim to be a lost volume seller

words.enDefinition: monetary compensation for sufficiently established profits that would have been earned absent the actionable breach

examples.en: The fictional claimant supported lost profit damages with sales records rather than relying only on projected revenue.
examples.zh: 虚构请求人以销售记录支持「利润损失赔偿」请求，并辅以对预期收入的说明。

examples.en: We subtracted the costs that would have been incurred before calculating the modeled lost profit damages in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在计算示例「利润损失赔偿」前，扣除了原本应发生的成本。

words.enDefinition: the loss of value the injured party expected to receive from the contractual exchange

examples.en: The model judgment discusses loss of bargain by comparing what was promised with what the claimant actually received.
examples.zh: 示例判决比较合同承诺与请求人的实际所得，从而讨论「丧失合同利益」。

examples.en: We distinguished loss of bargain from an expense that the buyer incurred before either party performed.
examples.zh: 我们区分「丧失合同利益」与双方尚未履行时买方支出的一笔费用。

words.enDefinition: loss that falls within the applicable test for what the parties or breaching party could anticipate when contracting

examples.en: The seminar considered foreseeable contractual loss using information available to the parties when they made the fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 研讨课根据当事人订立虚构协议时可得的信息，讨论「可预见的合同损失」。

examples.en: We checked whether the claimed foreseeable contractual loss followed from circumstances discussed before the contract was signed.
examples.zh: 我们核对所主张的「可预见的合同损失」是否源于签约前讨论过的相关情形。

words.enDefinition: the limitation that excludes contractual losses too remote under the applicable tests of responsibility and foreseeability

examples.en: The case note addressed remoteness of contractual loss separately from whether the breach caused the loss.
examples.zh: 案例注释将「合同损失过远性」与违约事实上是否造成损失分别讨论。

examples.en: We read the English judgment's discussion of remoteness of contractual loss after identifying the parties' agreement and circumstances.
examples.zh: 我们先梳理当事人的约定和相关情形，再阅读英格兰判决中关于「合同损失过远性」的论述。

collocations: test for remoteness of contractual loss
rule on remoteness of contractual loss

words.enDefinition: the requirement under applicable law that loss and its amount be supported to the required level of certainty

examples.en: The fictional court discussed certainty of damages because the claimant's projection depended on several assumptions without supporting records.
examples.zh: 因请求人的预测依赖数项缺乏记录支持的假设，虚构法院讨论了「损害赔偿的确定性」。

examples.en: We compared the two estimates when studying certainty of damages in the mock contract appeal from class.
examples.zh: 学习课堂虚构合同上诉案中的「损害赔偿的确定性」时，我们对照了两种估计。

collocations: meet the certainty of damages requirement

words.enDefinition: loss that reasonable action after a breach could have prevented, relevant to limits on damages

examples.en: The exercise treated certain extra storage charges as avoidable loss under its assumptions about the injured party's options.
examples.zh: 练习按对受损方可选措施的假设，将某些额外仓储费用视为「可避免的损失」。

examples.en: We separated avoidable loss from expenses that remained necessary even after the fictional buyer found a substitute.
examples.zh: 我们将「可避免的损失」与虚构买方找到替代品后仍无法省掉的费用区分开来。

words.enDefinition: reasonable steps to limit loss from breach, relevant to what damages are recoverable under the governing rules

examples.en: The class considered mitigation of contractual loss after the fictional buyer found comparable goods at another supplier.
examples.zh: 虚构买方从另一家供应方找到相当货物后，全班讨论了「减轻合同损失」。

examples.en: We distinguished reasonable steps for mitigation of contractual loss from steps that would have imposed disproportionate expense.
examples.zh: 我们区分为「减轻合同损失」采取的合理措施与会造成不相称开支的措施。

collocations: take steps for mitigation of contractual loss

words.enDefinition: the reasonable expense of correcting defective performance, used as a possible measure of loss in some contexts

examples.en: The classroom example compared the cost of cure with the lower value of the model item as delivered.
examples.zh: 课堂示例将「修补费用」与所交付示例物的价值减损作比较。

examples.en: We checked whether the mock court used the cost of cure to measure the loss from defective work.
examples.zh: 我们核对虚构法院是否用「修补费用」来衡量工作有瑕疵造成的损失。

collocations: damages measured by the cost of cure

words.enDefinition: the reduction in value caused by a defect or breach, used as a loss measure in the stated context

examples.en: The exercise calculated diminution in value by comparing the promised item with the one actually received.
examples.zh: 练习将约定交付的物品与实际收到的物品比较，计算「价值减损」。

examples.en: We compared diminution in value with repair costs when reading the hypothetical decision in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读假设判决时，将「价值减损」与修理费用相对照。

collocations: damages based on diminution in value

words.enDefinition: a court order requiring a party to perform a contractual obligation, available only under applicable conditions

examples.en: The mock court considered specific performance because the agreement concerned an item with no readily available substitute.
examples.zh: 虚构法院考虑「强制实际履行」，因为协议所涉物品没有容易获得的替代品。

examples.en: We read the English law problem's separate discussion of specific performance and monetary damages for the same breach.
examples.zh: 我们阅读英格兰法例题中对同一违约的「强制实际履行」和金钱赔偿的分别讨论。

words.enDefinition: relief founded on equitable principles and subject to applicable discretionary standards, such as specific performance or an injunction

examples.en: The chart placed specific performance under equitable remedy and listed ordinary damages in a separate column.
examples.zh: 图表将强制实际履行列入「衡平法救济」，并在另一栏列出通常的损害赔偿。

examples.en: We checked the conditions for the equitable remedy in the fictional opinion before discussing the result.
examples.zh: 讨论结果前，我们先核对虚构判词中授予「衡平法救济」的条件。

words.enDefinition: a court order restraining or sometimes requiring action in connection with a contractual right

examples.en: The fictional claimant requested a contractual injunction to protect a restricted use of material under the assigned agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构请求人申请「合同禁令」，以保护题设协议对资料用途作出的限制。

examples.en: The class compared a proposed contractual injunction with an award of damages limited to past use.
examples.zh: 全班将拟议的「合同禁令」与只对已经发生的使用给予赔偿的裁决作比较。

words.enDefinition: whether a monetary award would sufficiently protect the claimant's right, relevant to certain equitable remedies

examples.en: The mock opinion discussed adequacy of damages before deciding whether to consider ordering performance of the particular promise.
examples.zh: 虚构判词在决定是否考虑命令履行特定承诺之前，讨论了「损害赔偿的充分性」。

examples.en: We examined adequacy of damages using the assumed availability of comparable substitute items in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据是否假设有相当替代物可得，考察「损害赔偿的充分性」。

words.enDefinition: a remedy following breach that restores a benefit conferred or its value when the applicable legal requirements are satisfied

examples.en: The fictional buyer requested restitution for breach to recover a payment made before the promised work was abandoned.
examples.zh: 虚构买方请求「违约后的返还救济」，以收回承诺工作被放弃前已支付的款项。

examples.en: The exercise considered restitution for breach separately from a demand for the profits expected under the agreement.
examples.zh: 练习将「违约后的返还救济」与请求合同预期利润分别考虑。

words.enDefinition: a claim for reasonable payment for work or services in settings recognized by governing law

examples.en: The seminar discussed quantum meruit after the fictional provider completed work whose price was still in dispute.
examples.zh: 虚构服务提供者完成工作但价款仍有争议后，研讨课讨论了「合理报酬请求」。

examples.en: We considered the value of services already supplied when reading the hypothetical quantum meruit claim in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读假设的「合理报酬请求」时，考虑了已提供服务的价值。

collocations: value of services under quantum meruit

words.enDefinition: retention of a benefit at another's expense in circumstances that the applicable legal system recognizes as unjust

examples.en: The class discussed unjust enrichment after reading about a payment received twice in the fictional account records.
examples.zh: 全班在阅读虚构账目中同一款项被收取两次的情况之后，讨论了「不当得利」。

examples.en: We distinguished unjust enrichment from damages measured by what the contract would have delivered under the stipulated facts.
examples.zh: 在题设事实下，我们区分了「不当得利」与按合同本可履行的利益计算的赔偿。

words.enDefinition: under English law, setting a closely connected cross-claim against a claim where enforcing payment separately would be unjust

examples.en: The English law problem asks whether equitable set-off applies to two claims arising from closely related performance.
examples.zh: 英格兰法例题问，由密切相关的履行产生的两项请求是否可以「衡平抵销」。

examples.en: We discussed the relationship between the two claims before assessing equitable set-off in the hypothetical dispute.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论两项请求之间的关系，再判断假设争议中是否适用「衡平抵销」。

words.enDefinition: a remedy reducing the price owed or requiring repayment of part of the price under applicable sales or consumer rules

examples.en: The seminar compared a price reduction remedy with replacement in the example based on UK consumer law.
examples.zh: 研讨课在以英国消费者法为基础的示例中，对照了「减价救济」和更换。

examples.en: We used a diagram to show the portion of the price affected by the price reduction remedy.
examples.zh: 我们用示意图显示「减价救济」会影响哪一部分价款。

collocations: conditions for the price reduction remedy

words.enDefinition: under the UK Consumer Rights Act 2015, an initial statutory right to reject certain nonconforming goods within applicable limits

examples.en: The UK worksheet distinguishes the short-term right to reject from later options for nonconforming goods under the Act.
examples.zh: 英国法练习区分了「短期拒收权」与该法针对不合约货物规定的后续选项。

examples.en: We identified where the short-term right to reject appeared in the sequence of remedies in the assigned statute.
examples.zh: 我们在指定法规的救济顺序中，找出「短期拒收权」所处的位置。

collocations: exercise the short-term right to reject
limits on the short-term right to reject

words.enDefinition: under applicable UK consumer law, performing a service again as necessary to bring it into conformity with the contract

examples.en: The class examined repeat performance of a service as one statutory response in the fictional UK consumer example.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「重新提供服务」作为虚构英国消费者案例中的一项法定应对方式分析。

examples.en: We compared repeat performance of a service with a reduction of the agreed price in the assigned reading.
examples.zh: 我们在指定阅读中，将「重新提供服务」与减少约定价款作对比。

collocations: request repeat performance of a service
provide repeat performance of a service
conditions for repeat performance of a service

words.enDefinition: a seller's legal claim for the price agreed for goods when the applicable law allows recovery of the price itself

examples.en: The New York exercise considered an action for the price after the buyer accepted goods without paying.
examples.zh: 买方接受虚构货物却没有付款后，纽约州练习讨论了「价款给付之诉」。

examples.en: We distinguished an action for the price from a claim measured by resale losses in the training case.
examples.zh: 我们将「价款给付之诉」与按转售损失计算金额的培训案例请求区分开。

collocations: bring an action for the price
maintain an action for the price
grounds for an action for the price

words.enDefinition: interest on a recoverable amount for a period before judgment, if the governing rules grant it

examples.en: The hypothetical award listed prejudgment interest separately from the principal amount due under the fictional supply agreement.
examples.zh: 假设裁决将「判决前利息」与虚构供货协议下应付的本金分别列明。

examples.en: We read the date assumptions before comparing prejudgment interest amounts in the classroom's contract claims table.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读对日期的假设，再比较课堂合同请求表里的「判决前利息」金额。

words.enDefinition: a term specifying when interest accrues on a sum and how it is determined under the agreement

examples.en: The contractual interest clause set out how interest would accrue on overdue installments in the fictional plan.
examples.zh: 虚构付款计划的「合同利息条款」规定逾期分期款如何计息。

examples.en: We checked whether the contractual interest clause applied before comparing it with the fictional judgment's interest award.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「合同利息条款」是否适用，再与虚构判决判给的利息作比较。

collocations: scope of a contractual interest clause

words.enDefinition: a directly stated event or requirement on which a duty to pay depends

examples.en: The hypothetical purchase order describes a signed receipt as an express condition of payment for the delivery.
examples.zh: 假设采购订单将签收的收据规定为对该交付的「明示付款条件」。

examples.en: We highlighted the wording of the express condition of payment in the materials for the contract seminar.
examples.zh: 我们在合同研讨课资料中突出标记了「明示付款条件」的措辞。

collocations: satisfy an express condition of payment
waive an express condition of payment
identify an express condition of payment

words.zhGloss: 救济途径的根本目的落空
words.enDefinition: in US sales law, the failure of a designated remedy to provide the basic relief for which it was agreed
acceptedZhAnswers: 救济途径的根本目的落空

examples.en: The New York discussion addressed failure of essential purpose when the sole remedy could not provide repair.
examples.zh: 虚构的唯一救济无法提供约定修理时，纽约州课堂讨论了「救济途径的根本目的落空」。

examples.en: We considered failure of essential purpose and separately reviewed the fictional contract's exclusion of consequential damages.
examples.zh: 我们分别考虑「救济途径的根本目的落空」和假设合同中另一条款是否排除后果性损失赔偿。

collocations: finding of failure of essential purpose
limited remedy subject to failure of essential purpose

words.enDefinition: performance different from the one initially specified but provided instead under an agreement or applicable rule

examples.en: The fictional problem treats the alternate delivery method as substituted performance permitted by the stated sales rule.
examples.zh: 虚构例题将另一种交付方式视为指定买卖规则允许的「替代履行」。

examples.en: We identified the substituted performance before reviewing why the original delivery method was unavailable in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们先找出「替代履行」方式，再考察练习中原交付方式为何不可用。

words.enDefinition: a contract whose corresponding parts of performance can be treated as separate exchanges under the governing rules

examples.en: The problem describes a divisible contract in which payment for each finished unit corresponded to its delivery.
examples.zh: 例题描述一项「可分合同」，每个完工单元的款项对应于该单元的交付。

examples.en: We discussed whether a divisible contract analysis allowed recovery for the portions already performed in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们讨论，按「可分合同」分析是否允许就练习中已经履行的部分取得款项。

words.enDefinition: a contractual obligation treated as one whole rather than as separate parts for purposes such as entitlement to payment

examples.en: The class considered an entire obligation where payment depended on delivering the finished work as a whole.
examples.zh: 在约定对价以整体交付完工成果为条件的情形中，全班讨论了「不可分履行义务」。

examples.en: We compared the entire obligation with separate duties attached to individual deliveries in another hypothetical contract.
examples.zh: 我们将「不可分履行义务」与另一假设合同中附属于每次交付的独立义务对照。

collocations: payment subject to an entire obligation

words.enDefinition: return of money paid before performance when required by the agreement, a remedy or the applicable law

examples.en: The fictional buyer sought repayment of an advance after the seller failed to supply the listed items.
examples.zh: 卖方未交付课堂例题列出的物品后，虚构买方请求「返还预付款」。

examples.en: We checked the timing of repayment of an advance against the dates given in the model settlement.
examples.zh: 我们将「返还预付款」的时间与示例和解协议给出的日期相核对。

collocations: terms for repayment of an advance

words.expression: damages in lieu of specific performance
words.lemma: damages in lieu of specific performance
words.enDefinition: a monetary award made instead of specific performance when the court has authority to grant such relief
acceptedEnVariants: damages in lieu of specific performance

examples.en: After reviewing the circumstances, the mock judgment considered an award of damages in lieu of specific performance.
examples.zh: 虚构判决中，法院审查承诺的相关情形之后，考虑了「替代实际履行的赔偿」。

examples.en: We distinguished damages in lieu of specific performance from an actual order directing the seller to perform.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「替代实际履行的赔偿」和实际命令卖方履行的裁定。

collocations: award damages in lieu of specific performance
seek damages in lieu of specific performance
availability of damages in lieu of specific performance

words.enDefinition: omission of a communication required under a contract or legal rule, with consequences depending on the applicable terms

examples.en: The hypothetical court examined failure to give notice as a separate issue from the delivery defect itself.
examples.zh: 假设法院将「未发出通知」与交付瑕疵本身作为两个独立问题审查。

examples.en: We considered whether failure to give notice changed the remedy available under the fictional agreement's stated terms.
examples.zh: 我们讨论，依照虚构协议写明的条款，「未发出通知」是否改变可获得的救济。

collocations: consequences of failure to give notice

words.enDefinition: a contractual provision or effect preventing a specified claim from being brought or maintained when legally effective

examples.en: The mock opinion discusses a contractual claims bar tied to a requirement in the parties' fictional agreement.
examples.zh: 虚构判词讨论了与当事方虚构协议中一项要求相关的「合同请求权限制」。

examples.en: We identified which claims the contractual claims bar purported to cover in the classroom case note.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂案例注释中识别「合同请求权限制」拟涵盖哪些请求。

collocations: limits on a contractual claims bar

words.enDefinition: keeping remedies available by agreement, an express reservation or another legally effective means

examples.en: The classroom agreement addressed preservation of contractual remedies when one party continued accepting performance while disputing a charge.
examples.zh: 课堂协议谈到，当一方继续接受履行并对一项费用提出异议时，如何「保留合同救济」。

examples.en: We reviewed the letter's wording before discussing preservation of contractual remedies in the fictional performance dispute.
examples.zh: 我们先审阅函件的措辞，再讨论虚构履行争议中的「保留合同救济」。

collocations: clause on preservation of contractual remedies
effect on preservation of contractual remedies
dispute over preservation of contractual remedies

words.enDefinition: a period specified for giving notice or for time to pass after notice before it takes effect

examples.en: The model termination letter referred to the contractual notice period listed in the agreement signed by both parties.
examples.zh: 示例终止函提到双方签署的协议里列明的「合同约定的通知期」。

examples.en: We tracked the contractual notice period using the separate dates shown for sending and receipt in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们按练习中各自列出的发出与收悉日期，追踪「合同约定的通知期」。

collocations: comply with a contractual notice period
expiry of the contractual notice period

words.enDefinition: the point when a contract claim comes into existence under the applicable rules, often relevant to limitation periods

examples.en: The hypothetical opinion analyzed accrual of a contract claim by comparing the promised delivery date with later events.
examples.zh: 假设判词将约定的交付日与后续事件相对照，分析「合同请求权的发生」。

examples.en: We placed the accrual of a contract claim on the timeline before discussing the applicable time limit.
examples.zh: 我们在讨论适用的时限之前，先把「合同请求权的发生」标到时间线上。

collocations: determine accrual of a contract claim
date of accrual of a contract claim
rule governing accrual of a contract claim

words.enDefinition: a contract claim that cannot be maintained because the applicable period for bringing it has expired, subject to exceptions

examples.en: The classroom case note reports a time-barred contract claim after applying the stipulated limitation rule to the facts.
examples.zh: 课堂案例注释将规定的时效规则适用于事实后，记录了一项「超过时效的合同请求」。

examples.en: We traced the dates used by the mock court to classify the demand as a time-barred contract claim.
examples.zh: 我们追踪虚构法院所用的几个日期，了解该请求为什么被列为「超过时效的合同请求」。

collocations: defence to a time-barred contract claim

words.enDefinition: two or more remedies for a contractual failure that may coexist under the applicable rules

examples.en: The judge in the worksheet considered concurrent contractual remedies while ensuring the same loss was compensated only once.
examples.zh: 练习中的法官考虑「并存的合同救济」，同时确保同一损失只获赔一次。

examples.en: We reviewed concurrent contractual remedies without assuming that every requested combination was allowed under the stated law.
examples.zh: 我们依照指定法律审查「并存的合同救济」，没有把所有请求的组合都假定为可行。
